notes: The first quarterly planning day after the Kick Off. The objective is functional clarity with team accountability, and better execution.

slides.title: What would make today valuable?
slides.headline: What would make today valuable?
notes: Ask each person to write an answer and share it. Agree on the outcomes. Return to them at the close. Allow 10 minutes.

The coach’s own outcome is “Functional clarity with team accountability”. Hold it back until everyone has shared theirs, so it does not lead the room. It shows on the “Did we get what we came for?” slide.
